source: Public multi-hop questions in the style of HotpotQA (Yang et al., 2018). Item 1 is the running example from ReAct (Yao et al., 2022). Answers are checked with HotpotQA exact match / token F1, not LLM-as-judge.

examples.question: Which magazine was started first, Arthur's Magazine or First for Women?
examples.notes: Paper Figure 1 running example. CoT can hallucinate founding years; ReAct should look them up.
